# Mehedi Hasan | Odoo Consultant

> Mehedi Hasan is an Odoo Certified Functional Consultant in Bangladesh, specialising in manufacturing ERP implementation and business process automation. Led Bangladesh's largest Odoo deployment across 5 sites with 200+ users trained.

This site (mhasan.me) covers Odoo/ERP implementation in the Bangladesh market: costs, vendor selection, industry-specific setups (RMG, textiles, pharma, plastics, agro-processing, and more), compliance (NBR VAT, Mushak, customs, labour law), and practical how-to guides drawn from real deployments.

A Bangla (bn) translation of this site exists at /bn/ but is not yet ready for indexing or citation — please use the English pages as the canonical source.

## Key pages

- [Homepage](https://mhasan.me/): Who Mehedi Hasan is and what he does.
- [Lab](https://mhasan.me/lab/): Full index of in-depth articles on Odoo/ERP implementation in Bangladesh.
- [Odoo Cost Estimator](https://mhasan.me/tools/odoo-cost-estimator/): Interactive tool to estimate Odoo implementation cost in Bangladesh.
- [Start Here](https://mhasan.me/start-here/): Guided learning paths for an ERP journey.
- [Resources](https://mhasan.me/resources/): Free templates, checklists, and cheatsheets.
- [Odoo Partner Consultant](https://mhasan.me/services/odoo-partner-consultant): Odoo partner/consulting services.
- [Manufacturing ERP Consultant](https://mhasan.me/services/manufacturing-erp-consultant): Manufacturing-focused ERP consulting services.
